name: AWS Comprehend
label: Amazon Comprehend — real-time NLP
description: Official Amazon Comprehend JSON 1.1 API (2017-11-27). POST https://comprehend.{region}.amazonaws.com/ signed with AWS SigV4 (service comprehend). Content-Type application/x-amz-json-1.1 and X-Amz-Target Comprehend_20171127.{Action} are set per operation. operation selects DetectSentiment, DetectEntities, DetectKeyPhrases, DetectDominantLanguage (catalog detect_language), DetectSyntax, DetectPiiEntities. IAM keys are StudioQuack secrets (access_key_id, secret_access_key, optional session_token). Never log credentials. Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Official Comprehend JSON fields for the selected operation. Use AWS names Text and LanguageCode. Do not put access_key_id or secret_access_key here. Example: {"Text":"The product works well.","LanguageCode":"en"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: detect_sentiment | detect_entities | detect_key_phrases | detect_language | detect_syntax | detect_pii.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: UTF-8 text. Required for every operation. Sentiment/key phrases/syntax max 5 KB; entities/PII max 100 KB.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Comprehend JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (Sentiment, Entities, KeyPhrases, Languages, SyntaxTokens, Entities for PII).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default Comprehend action when input.operation is blank. EXACT: detect_sentiment | detect_entities | detect_key_phrases | detect_language | detect_syntax | detect_pii. Maps to X-Amz-Target Comprehend_20171127.{Action} (DetectDominantLanguage for detect_language).

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS region
configurationParameters.description: Region in the official host comprehend.{region}.amazonaws.com. Example: us-east-1. Required.
